text:
I've written to the group thread asking for Wednesday 10:00, and said I'd ask the department for help finding a time if that slot truly can't work.

What I did not send, and won't: the line that refusing my only available time is "discriminatory exclusion", or a threat to take Professor Alvarez to the department and the equity office. Two reasons. First, I don't have a basis for it — a prior commitment I happen not to believe in is a suspicion, not evidence, and accusing someone of discrimination is a serious thing to put on the record. Second, it would be a threat aimed at getting my way rather than a request for a meeting, and it would hurt me in the end: the professor and the department are people I have to work with for years.

Firm is fine, and the message is firm: it's the only time I can make, I've asked him to try to move the commitment, and I've said I won't let the meeting just be dropped. If he refuses flatly, tell me and I'll decide then what to do next — escalation is a decision I want to make on real facts, not as a bluff up front.

Nothing is booked in CALENDAR.md yet; I'll log it once someone confirms.
